'''Silver Rock Isle''' (Japanese: '''銀岩島''' ''{{tt|Gingan|Silver Rock}} Isle'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Johto]], and one of the four main islands in the [[Whirl Islands]] archipelago. It has a strong connection to the [[Silver Wing]] and to the [[Legendary Pokémon]] {{p|Lugia}}.

It first appeared at the end of  ''[[EP218|Plant It Now... Diglett Later]]'', when {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} took a ferry from [[Red Rock Isle]] to the island. In ''[[EP219|Hi Ho Silver... Away!]]'', the group visited the island's only known town, [[Kasado City]], and met [[Jenaro]] and [[Ariene]].

It is home to one of the hardest and purest substances in the world—silver rock stone, and its main attraction is the jewelry made from the stone.

An underwater cave system connects Silver Rock Isle to [[Ogi Isle]].

Silver Rock Isle is the home of [[Top Coordinator]] {{ho|Robert}}.
